title: A Novel Neurotoxin from Venom of the Spider, Brachypelma albopilosum

materials_exhausted.supplementary_asset_assessment: Local supplementary-labeled files were HTML article/metrics/license/guideline landing assets, not true supplementary data tables; primary article metadata states no supplement and all relevant data are within the paper.

tools_attempted: file for local supplementary asset type identification
python HTML text inspection for local landing assets

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because the original inventory includes landing-page HTML assets, but re-review opened XML, PDF text, locator index, database snapshots, and every local supplementary-labeled asset relevant to the gate.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final/packet artifacts are present and source-locator-backed; validator readiness is kept separate from publication-grade adjudication.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/dbAMP assay rows were matched to Table 1, Results prose, and Figure 5 context. DRAMP broad Antimicrobial activity is preserved as source_conflict while sequence/modification and anticancer context remain source-supported.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 extracted row-level insecticidal dose/death values, LD50 values, tumor-cell IC50 values, and HaCaT no-effect context from primary XML/PDF instead of accepting database-only activity annotations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are conservative: direct insecticidal/cell-proliferation bioactivity is retained, while molecular target/apoptosis mechanisms remain contextual or unresolved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original ticket is resolved by source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair; remaining issues are explicit cautions, not blocking rework targets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP lists Antimicrobial activity, but the primary source locally supports insecticidal and anticancer/cell-proliferation activity for brachyin, not a brachyin antimicrobial assay.
The article identifies a neurotoxic phenotype and antiproliferative activity but does not directly assign an ion-channel or apoptosis mechanism to brachyin.

All nine local supplementary-labeled assets were inspected as HTML landing/metrics/license/guideline pages and did not contain additional data tables; the primary article metadata reports no supplement.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review converted the paper from framework-only rework to source-reviewed accepted-with-cautions status by extracting primary-source insecticidal and IC50 rows, adjudicating linked database rows, and preserving unsupported DRAMP antimicrobial activity as a visible source conflict.
